item.title: Caucus Elects New Jasper Mayor
item.description: Jasper has a new mayor following a party caucus held Friday night. Ryan Craig was selected by precinct committee members to fill the position. Craig currently serves on the Dubois County Council, representing the county’s second district.

item.title: Statehouse Update from Eric Bassler
item.description: State Senator Eric Bassler of Washington says that the focus of Senate Republicans are government reform, public safety, and fiscal discipline. In his weekly statehouse update he says all of that includes proposed changes to Indiana’s welfare system.
